Div and span tags stripped but content preserved

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"strip_tags\":[\"div\",\"span\"]}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<div class='wrapper'><p>Inside div</p></div><p>Outside <span class='hl'>span text</span></p>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
